verdict.rationale: YYLO documents a parallel-runner script for bounded concurrent fan-out across many independent kanban tasks/data items/commands with structured evidence, plus run-until-completion loops that repeat until all kanban work clears, showing genuine bulk-operation support. However this is a first-party docs claim without independent/hands-on corroboration or concrete scale numbers. Missing for 10: independent verification of the fan-out at scale, and more detail on failure handling across bulk items.
